title: China World Trade Center Tower III

references.observations: 330 m, 74 stories, completed 2010. Office entry is west and hotel entry east. Inspected Tim Griffith photos 03, 04, 01, 05, 07, 08, 12 and 16 from the page: full silhouette, recessed glazed corner, base diamonds, deep glazed canopy, lobby vestibules and adjacent structures. The tower is tapered and its crown has pronounced projecting fins and visible cross-bracing. The mall and pedestrian bridge are separate structures.

330 m; unitised curtain wall with insulated glazing and full-height external glass fins projecting 600 mm. Glazed wall undulates on alternating floors. LED strips run along outer fin edges. Brochure reports 80 above-ground floors and 83 including basements, differing from architect floor counts. Page 10 shows crown cross-bracing and service belts; page 11 shows fin brackets, curtain-wall folds and the separate retail cable wall. Retail wall is 22 m high and 100 m wide, outside this tower asset.

Uses 81 stories rather than current project-page 74. Describes an evacuation helipad, crown hotel facilities, sky lobby at labelled floor 64, and separate landscaped podium and water gardens. These story labels are not treated as a measured floor schedule.

Text identifies the tower, ballroom annex and retail annex separately. Uses a 74-story tower count and 330 m height. Website drawings were not successfully loaded and are not used as measured evidence.
Hotel occupies labelled floors 64 to 80 with 278 rooms. No physical floor elevations or construction dimensions are inferred directly from those labels.
